storage.title: Storage Used
storage.subtitle: You can see how much storage is used by the app and clear caches to free up space. Currently, the app is using {size} of storage.

clearNetworkCache.title: Clear Network Cache
clearNetworkCache.subtitle: Remove cached data from network requests to free up space and ensure you have the latest content.

success.title: Cache Cleared
success.content: All cached network data has been successfully cleared.

error.title: Error Clearing Cache
error.content: An error occurred while trying to clear the network cache. Please try again later.

clearTranslationCache.title: Clear Translation Cache
clearTranslationCache.subtitle: Remove cached translations to ensure you have the latest language updates.

success.title: Translations Cleared
success.content: All cached translations have been successfully cleared.

error.title: Error Clearing Translations
error.content: An error occurred while trying to clear the cached translations. Please try again later.
